{{color2|fff|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Sidney/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===GOTCHA!=== Sidney briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Hoenn Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Sidney in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:ORAS Gym Leaders Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|left|170px|Sidney in the thirteenth chapter]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== Sidney and the other Elite Four members were called by {{Steven}} to help protect the Hoenn [[region]] from the {{pkmn|battle}} between {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. Sidney was initially stationed at [[Desert Ruins]] as part of the plan to unseal {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}}. When the giants are unsealed, Sidney is tasked with controlling Regirock alongside Drake. The Elite Four, Steven, and Wallace all control the three [[legendary giants]] in three pairs of two and use their power to keep the power released from Groudon and Kyogre's battle from spreading throughout Hoenn. They manage to keep the power contained for several weeks, but the strain is too much for Steven and he eventually dies, causing the three Pokémon to lash out and flee. Sidney later mourns Steven's death before his revival at the hands of {{adv|Ruby}}'s {{p|Celebi}}. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== Sidney, along with various people from around Hoenn, is called to [[Sootopolis City]] to assist in stopping [[Grand Meteor Delta]], a giant meteoroid threatening to destroy the planet. When the plan to attack Grand Meteor Delta starts, Sidney and the others have their Pokémon attack the meteoroid at the same time. This, combined with the might of [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, successfully shatters Grand Meteor Delta into pieces. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Sidney's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sidney |pkmn=Zangoose |gender=male |type1=Normal |img=Sidney Zangoose Adventures.png |epnum=PS251 |epname=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIII |desc={{p|Zangoose}} is Sidney's only known Pokémon. He was used to awaken the chamber containing Regirock. Zangoose's known moves are {{m|Brick Break}} and {{m|Crush Claw}}, and his Ability is {{a|Immunity}}.}} =====Temporary===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sidney |pkmn=Regirock |type1=Rock |img=Brandon Regirock Adventures.png |epnum=PS254 |epname=A Royal Rumble with Regirock, Regice, & Registeel II |main=Brandon's legendary giants |main_section=Pokémon Adventures |desc={{p|Regirock}} was awakened by Steven and the Elite Four to be used to contain Groudon and Kyogre's power. Sidney controlled Regirock with Drake while the others controlled Regice and Registeel. After Steven died from the strain of controlling the three Pokémon, Regirock lashed out and ran away. However, [[Karen]] of the [[Generation II]] Elite Four is also a specialist in the {{t|Dark}} type. * In {{2v2|Ruby|Sapphire}}, Sidney is the only Elite Four member to not use two of the same Pokémon or use two Pokémon from the same evolutionary line. * In Ruby, Sapphire, and {{game|Emerald}}, Sidney owns a {{p|Shiftry}} that knows {{m|Extrasensory}} at level 48, which Shiftry [[Game move errors|does not learn]] until level 49 as a {{p|Nuzleaf}}. * All of Sidney's Pokémon in the first battle give out at least one Attack EV. In addition, all of them have their base Attack as their highest stat. ** His {{p|Cacturne}} is the only Pokémon he uses that does not give out at least two Attack EVs.
